mapper.select:
select count(*) as count from tb_notice where notice_del_yn = 'N'
and notice_title like CONCAT('%', #{searchWord}, '%')
and notice_content like CONCAT('%', #{searchWord}, '%')
and (notice_title like CONCAT('%', #{searchWord}, '%') OR notice_content like CONCAT('%', #{searchWord}, '%'))
and notice_writer_name = #{searchWord}

select notice_seq_no as noticeSeqNo , notice_title as noticeTitle , notice_content as noticeContent , notice_writer as noticeWriter , notice_writer_name as noticeWriterName , notice_hit_cnt as noticeHitCnt , notice_del_yn as noticeDelYn , notice_date as noticeDate , notice_up_date as noticeUpdate , notice_up_user as noticeUpUser from tb_notice where notice_seq_no = #{noticeSeqNo}
